request_contract.parameter_rules: Exact published version and filename only. Historical data-file GET used download=1; code used exact API content path. Documentation-only; no new live request, scheduled fetch or bulk transfer authorized.

response_contract.format: Python 3.9 study-specific model/reproduction code; dependency CLIMADA platform and public crop/radar/damage-grid research records
response_contract.scientific_semantics: NHESS 10.5194/nhess-24-2541-2024 provides DOI 10.5281/zenodo.12784190 for the published study code, as well as links to the three separately identified data assets in this shard. CLIMADA's cited platform license is GPL-3.0; do not assume the same license applies to all study code or linked third-party datasets. This is a hail crop-damage footprint classification research model, not an Oasis-ready insured loss model: pin archive checksum, code/dependency versions, valid tests and scientific limits before use. Review actual per-file code licences and dependency compatibility, including CLIMADA GPL-3.0, separately from deposit CC BY label. Do not execute downloaded code without isolation and review; method reproduces binary crop footprints, not monetary losses.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No new automated requests authorized. Review current Zenodo service terms, aggregate transfer budget, exact file and acquisition scope before any replay.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Version-specific record ID and publisher MD5; record exact observed size, SHA-256 and retrieval time separately for every asset. Do not replace original release with concept DOI or latest version.
